_what: How the work an actor wrote is told apart from the work that stayed (src/kept-work.mjs). A text's versions, oldest first, each with who wrote it (the change's actor `by`), are broken into lines; a line is credited to whoever first wrote it, by the BLAKE3 identity of the line (`normalize` says how a line is made comparable), and the credit is kept only for lines still in the newest version. `blank_lines` counts empty lines as nobody's. `credit_by` names the actor field credit goes by. `track` says which writes are attributed as they happen (src/kept-work.mjs makeKeptWork): a record whose type starts with one of `type_prefixes` and whose value holds text in one of `fields` has its lines credited to the actor of the write, at most `max_lines` lines kept per record field.
